substantive_checks.simultaneous_nonresidue: PASS: CRT over the complete known candidate-prime set constructs 1<=d_M<B_M that is a quadratic nonresidue at every candidate without using the unknown collision subset
substantive_checks.raw_norm_bridge: PASS: each candidate prime divides both raw coordinates once automatically, so the raw norm has valuation exactly two off the gate and at least four on the full collision
substantive_checks.normalized_norm_bridge: PASS: after forced Cartier division the pair is a common local-unit multiple of the divided coordinates, and p divides the norm exactly on the full gate; a collision contributes at least p^2
substantive_checks.coefficient_height: PASS: d_M<B_M and the candidate interval PNT give log d_M<=M/6+o(M); no subexponential least-simultaneous-nonresidue claim is inferred from the finite replay
substantive_checks.height_barrier: PASS: a coefficient of exponent delta gives the inherited raw ratio H/2+delta/4 and normalized ratio H-kappa+delta/2; even delta=0 is far above the raw 1/6 support
substantive_checks.row_rule_aggregation: PASS: separate row norms have superlinear aggregate height, while one CRT interpolation returns to the same coefficient-height ledger
substantive_checks.finite_false_positives: PASS: seven simple parameter rules have exact actual noncollision zeros and are labeled finite witnesses only
substantive_checks.reservoir_deoverlap: PASS: the norm powers are algebraic powers of the same normalized two-coordinate collision ideal and create no independent Item-149 valuation copy
substantive_checks.capacity_booking: PASS: no cancellation or prime-factor localization theorem for the exact norm is proved; the 1/36-per-6M ceiling and booking remain unchanged

strict_scope.proved: One parameter-dependent CRT norm exactly scalarizes every actual fixed-j1 candidate gate, but divisibility plus componentwise absolute height cannot make it capacity-useful.
strict_scope.finite_only: The bounded least-coefficient scan and seven simple-rule false positives are exact witnesses and imply no asymptotic nonresidue or collision distribution.
strict_scope.open: Cancellation in the exact norm, localization of its prime factors, a useful rational row rule, and every c<1/6 isolated weighted bound remain open.
